column1: # The Black Mage fight per mode (hard / extreme) and phase (1-4), as GMS Hard runs phases 1-2; phases 3-4 and the
# Extreme timings follow the same field skills at estimated rates (no GMS run past phase 2 yet).
# Times in ms from the phase's start (its boss appearing); period 0 = once.
#   holder      the mob whose HP counts (HP from BossConstants.BLACK_MAGE_HP), at x y
#   linked      a mob whose hits go to the holder; it dies with it
#   ref         a mob the phase's field skills take their attacks from (Skill.wz FieldSkill.img mobattackref)
#   skill       field skill id / level; the actor plays action (MOB_FORCED_ACTION) as the skill goes off
#   wave        mob id at each of xs (y), with a notice lead ms before
#   timer       the big-pattern clock: level = the countdown sent (BLACK_MAGE_FIELD_TIMER 2), first/period = when it
#               runs out; then arg 1 also sends type 3, the actor's forced action and the notice
#   timerskill  field skill id / level, first ms after each time the timer runs out
#   walls       Shrieking Wall pair id (left) / actor (right): spawned first ms after each timerskill, one step in each
#   trigger     field skill id / level checked on the server first ms after the timer (BMTrigger2: the one whose
#               action the actor played), arg = the actor's action
#   marks       light / dark marks (BlackMageDebuff) every period
#   notice      the text at first (ms = how long it shows); popup = the boss tip box at entry; clear = when the
